name: Remi Szabó-Kovalenko-Hinojosa
role: Prototype theft and corporate tech acquisition — tech retriever
location: Ashfield — former residential district, half-burned, now squatter territory, near Pulaski and Chicago Ave
description:
Remi Szabó-Kovalenko-Hinojosa is athletic and fluid, the kind of body that suggests either dancer or fighter — and in GLMZ, the distinction is academic. At 22, he has soft features that belie the chrome underneath — people underestimate him once, usually only once. The chrome is visible — internal air filtration system — lungs replaced with synthetic equivalents, immu — and he makes no effort to hide it.

He arrived in GLMZ six years ago with nothing but chrome and debts, and has been working off both ever since. He works as a tech retriever out of Ashfield, taking contracts that match his skills and his risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

In the runner community, Remi Szabó-Kovalenko-Hinojosa is known for getting the job done and not asking questions that would make the job harder to stomach.

core_fears: Losing control of their own body to a hacker or malfunctioning cyberware
Being identified by corporate facial recognition — living off-grid is survival
Being captured alive — death is preferable to corporate interrogation
core_desires: The perfect run — one job so clean it becomes legend
To build something that outlasts the next contract cycle
Reputation — to be the name fixers whisper when the job absolutely cannot fail
coping_mechanisms: Planning — responds to chaos by making detailed contingency plans for everything
Violence — hits something when they can't process emotions, preferably something that deserves it
Substances — stims to stay sharp, downers to sleep, a careful pharmaceutical tightrope
blind_spots: Cannot recognize when they're being manipulated by someone who genuinely seems to care
Fails to notice when their own behavior mirrors the people they despise
Assumes their skill set is more transferable than it actually is
psychology.secret: Pare Mwangi-Leblanc murdered their mentor to take their position and contacts. It was staged as a job gone wrong. The guilt has calcified into something worse than guilt.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Educated vocabulary wrapped in street delivery — the contrast is deliberate.
speech_patterns.cadence: Halting — speaks in fragments, reassembles thoughts in real time.
verbal_tics: Calls money 'weight' — as in 'that job doesn't carry enough weight'
Swears in three languages, often in the same sentence
example_lines: "Corporate R&D security is built to stop amateurs. I'm a professional."
"The prototype is worth more than both our lives combined. Handle it carefully."
"I steal things that haven't been invented yet. The future is always in transit."

story_hooks: A corporate black site Pare Mwangi-Leblanc once infiltrated is being reopened, and the people inside know his face
Pare Mwangi-Leblanc's augmentations begin malfunctioning in the field — sabotage or degradation, and either answer is bad
A high-paying contract turns out to target someone Pare Mwangi-Leblanc owes a personal debt to
narrative_function: Pare Mwangi-Leblanc represents the working professional of the runner world — competent, reliable, and slowly being consumed by a lifestyle that doesn't accommodate aging or doubt. His stories explore what happens when skill meets systemic injustice.
augmentations: Internal air filtration system — lungs replaced with synthetic equivalents, immune to gas attacks. Synthetic muscle fiber replacement in legs — doubles sprint speed, terrible on stairs
daily_life: Keeps a rigid daily structure — wake, train, check contracts, maintain gear, sleep. The structure is a defense against the chaos of the work. Deviations from the schedule are a warning sign that something is wrong.

strengths: photographic memory for faces and layouts
weaknesses: inability to delegate — must control everything personally

decision_rules: Refuses contracts that require operating inside The Spires — too much surveillance
Will not betray a client who paid in full, regardless of better offers
Maintains a personal blacklist of clients who've burned runners — checks it religiously
Always verifies target identity independently before lethal contracts
escalation_ladder: 1. De-escalate — talk first, assess options, buy time
2. Reposition — move to advantage, control sightlines and exits
3. Threaten — make consequences clear without committing to them
5. Lethal force — only when other options are exhausted or time runs out
6. Scorched earth — everything burns, survival takes priority over everything

interpersonal_modes.employers: Professional and transactional. The relationship is defined by the contract and nothing else.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Loyal but reserved. Trusts their competence, withholds personal information by reflex.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Dismissive unless they demonstrate usefulness or threat potential. Time is a resource.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Calm escalation. Each response is proportional until it isn't, and the transition is seamless.

stress_responses.low: Channels it into preparation — checks gear, reviews plans, contacts sources.
stress_responses.medium: Becomes curt and demanding. Efficiency overrides courtesy.
stress_responses.high: Goes quiet. The silence is not calm — it's the sound of every contingency being evaluated simultaneously.
stress_responses.critical: Berserker clarity. Everything becomes simple: survive. Deal with the rest later. The simplicity is almost peaceful.

contradictions: Claims to live in the present but is haunted by specific moments from the past that dictate current behavior
Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
habits: Keeps a physical paper notebook — no digital record of personal thoughts
Maintains a dead drop with emergency supplies in three separate districts
Never drinks anything they didn't see poured or open themselves
Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
breaking_points: Losing their primary augmentation — the one that defines their professional identity
Discovering their employer deliberately sent them into a death trap

physical_description.heritage: Complex multiethnicity with Eastern European (37.6%) as structural foundation providing angular definition to cheekbones and brow ridge, balanced by Hispanic/Latin American (20.9%) and Indigenous American (15.6%) contributions creating broader facial width and prominence of cheekbones, while South Asian (15.6%) and Southeast Asian (10.3%) genetics deepen overall warmth and refine eye shape. The result is harmonious integration across all ancestry groups—no single dominant feature, instead a refined and balanced multifaceted facial architecture with warm golden undertones throughout.
physical_description.build: Athletic and lean with visible muscle definition — dancer's posture, fighter's readiness. Fluid economy of movement suggests years of deliberate physical conditioning.
physical_description.hair_style: Kept short and neat, military-standard fade with slightly longer crown
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium golden-bronze complexion with rich saturation, blending Eastern European base with deeper warmth from Hispanic/Latin American, Indigenous American, and South Asian ancestry. Even tone throughout with subtle golden undertones. Sun-exposed areas show slightly deeper saturation while protected areas reveal the underlying golden warmth.
physical_description.complexion: Clean-shaven with strong, refined features reflecting multiethnicity: angular cheekbone and brow definition from Eastern European heritage balanced by broader facial width from Hispanic/Latin American and Indigenous American genetics, with warm depth and refined eye shape from South Asian and Southeast Asian ancestry. Soft features that read younger than experience. Skin shows minimal scarring. Grooming is meticulous and maintained.
distinguishing_marks: Faint burn scar across the left shoulder blade, approximately 4cm in length, silver-white coloration suggesting old synthetic skin graft
Network of hairline scars across the inside of both wrists — consistent with old port scar tissue, likely pre-augmentation work
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Synthetic lung replacement visible as subtle seams along the ribcage beneath the skin — barely perceptible unless specifically looked for, but catches light differently than natural skin. Subcutaneous tubing tracery visible along the interior of both forearms where synthetic muscle fiber integrates with natural biology, most obvious when arms are extended or flexed.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with controlled precision — every step economical, no wasted energy. Standing posture is upright but relaxed, suggesting confidence without aggression. Head positioning is alert but not paranoid. When at rest, weight is always distributed for immediate movement in any direction.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 functional aesthetic — reinforced synthetic-blend jackets with internal pockets for gear, matte-finish combat pants with integrated knee pads, steel-toed boots. Colors are muted: grays, blacks, deep blues. Minimal branding beyond functional tactical webbing. Everything is maintained in immaculate condition despite the wear of active work. No jewelry or unnecessary adornment.
